name: Char_Glass_1S
kuro_shading_model: MSM_ToonCommon (lit forward translucent; ported as unlit + ForwardLighting)
kuro_asm: M_Char_Glass PS 474cc6dc0d (#215181, MI_R2T1YuanwuMd10011Glass) / VS 3be53aa34d (#2466); UseGradientOpacity + UseMatCap + UseVertexNormal + UseHeightLightTex, one-sided
resolve_note: lit forward translucent (Kuro MSM_ToonCommon, BLEND_Translucent), not a toon GBuffer: UE translucent UNLIT material with Emissive Color = X.Emissive + ForwardLighting and Opacity = X.Opacity. ForwardLighting = (Kuro glass ambient on the albedo + Kuro local-light loop) / EyeAdaptation, computed in the entry from explicit engine inputs (spec kinds view / primitive / kuro_light_buffer / engine_texture_load). Kuro engine tail, not ported (UE applies its own fog/blending): opacity *= Kuro primitive fade (Primitive[43]); emissive = max(E, 0) * View[285] unless Primitive[42].w; OOB stripes; colour = ForwardLighting + emissive; vertex / volumetric fog (TEXCOORD7); o0 = (max(colour, 0), opacity), single render target, no effect grading. Verified with that tail reproduced in the harness (tools/shaderdiff/weapons/hlsl/kuro_tail_glass.hlsli).
vs_note: VS #2466 (3be53aa34d): engine_only - reads no Material-CB value (cb declarations View / Primitive / GPU-skin only); stock GPU-skin passthrough translucent VS with vertex height fog (TEXCOORD7). See r3/glass_vs_status.py.

Emissive.kuro: material Emissive Color (before the engine translucent tail: fog, OOB, Kuro effect grading)

Opacity.kuro: material Opacity (o0.a = o1.a after the tail)

ForwardLighting.kuro: lit term (lw * ambient-lit albedo + local-light sum) / EyeAdaptation, added to max(E,0)*View[285] before fog

inputs.name: EyeAdaptation
inputs.kuro: t1 (1x1 eye-adaptation texture) .Load(int3(0, 0, 0)).x; the lit term is divided by it
inputs.harness: synthetic value in texel (0, 0) of t1

inputs.name: KuroLocalLights
inputs.kuro: cbuffer 3 of the PS (float4[145], dynamically indexed): Kuro forward local-light list. light i = rows 9i..9i+8, row 144.x = light count (uint bits): +0 xyz world position, w 1/radius; +1 xyz spot direction, w uint flags (bits 16..17 == 2: spot); +2 x spot cos(outer), y 1/(cos(inner) - cos(outer)); +3 xyz transmission colour [U], w weight on the ambient-lit albedo [U]; +4 x enable (!= 0) and distance-falloff scale, y falloff bias, z falloff multiplier; +5 xyz lit colour, w wrap-light threshold [U]; +6 xyz shadow colour [U], w lerp(distance falloff, radius fade); +7 x intensity, y transmission occlusion [U], w uint lighting-channel mask (compared << 5 with (primitive LightingChannelMask & 7) << 5); +8 x wrap width [U], y > 0 selects the lerp light model [U]
inputs.note: No UE material node provides this: the generator / plugin must bind a float4[145] buffer filled from the scene local lights (UE ForwardLightData is a different, culled format). With count 0 the glass is lit by the view ambient only.

inputs.name: E_Tex_RotCos
inputs.ue_nodes: Cosine[Period 0](Multiply(Multiply(ScalarParameter "E_Tex_Rotation", 0.002778 = 0x3B360F1B), 6.28319 = 0x40C90FDB)) as a uniform expression (float32 CPU; GPU sincos is not bit-identical)

notes.textures: texture parameters in t-slot order of the cooked map (MatCapTex t2, E_Tex_NoiseTex t3, HeightLightTex t4) as listed by the map's texture table; t0 = volumetric-fog 3D texture and t1 = eye adaptation are engine textures. MatCapTex = vertex-normal matcap (UseMatCap + UseVertexNormal), E_Tex_NoiseTex = effect layer (alpha source of the dissolve), HeightLightTex = panned height-light streak (UseHeightLightTex). Not overridden: E_Tex_NoiseTex (root default).

ue_material.contract: entry returns FWuwaFXOutput {float3 Emissive; float Opacity;} + out float3 ForwardLighting - no toon GBuffer, no WuwaToonResolve
ue_material.note: standard translucent (SrcAlpha / InvSrcAlpha); Kuro lights the glass itself, so every light value is an explicit input: see engine_inputs. UE applies its own fog.
